name: feellink-backend
buildCommand: export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://localhost:5432/feellink-build}" && export DIRECT_URL="${DIRECT_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}" && (npx prisma db push --skip-generate 2>&1 && echo 'DB schema synced' || echo 'DB push skipped') && npm run build
installCommand: export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-mongodb://localhost:27017/feellink-build}" && export NODE_ENV=development && (npm ci --legacy-peer-deps 2>/dev/null || npm install --legacy-peer-deps)
